method: Frames: newest SVS frame whose time T, and the raw times needed for the +-3 h scan, are covered by the raw OPeNDAP aggregation (frame times from build.discover); plus the frame 24 h earlier (extra.dayEarlier). Decoding: build.build_lut + build.decode, i.e. exactly the float grid the app quantises. Raw: GDS ASCII subsets (every 2nd 0.25-degree latitude, every 2nd longitude), averaged over the points inside each 1-degree cell (GEOS-FP 2-4 points, GEOS-CF 4 points). 'tavg1' sources are hourly means stamped mid-hour; the value at T is the mean of the hours T-1..T and T..T+1. Sampling: n cells without replacement, probability proportional to cos(latitude), numpy default_rng(seed), among cells where decoded and raw are both valid. Points whose raw value is outside the colorbar range are counted in 'clipped' and excluded from the stats. bias = mean(decoded - raw). Offset scan: same points, raw at T+h (h=-3..3) from the hourly source, clipped to the colorbar range; bestOffsetHours = argmax r (for the log-scale PM2.5 bar: argmax r of log10 values). extra.allCells: every valid unclipped cell, area-weighted, split into colour-measured cells and cells under the logo/date-label overlays that the decoder fills from neighbours. extra.forecastCheck: the same points against GEOS forecasts started in the 24 h before the frames were rendered; extra.forecastScan repeats the timing scan against the best-matching forecast. extra.impliedRange: least-squares fit of raw on decoded colorbar position, evaluated at the bar ends (diagnostic).
